sanskrit: janakena samādiṣṭā dūtās te klāntavāhanāḥ trirātram uṣitvā mārge te 'yodhyāṃ prāviśan purīm
english: Those messengers, dispatched by Janaka, with their mounts wearied, having rested three nights on the road, entered the city of Ayodhyā.

sanskrit: te rājavacanād dūtā rājaveśmapraveśitāḥ dadṛśur devasaṃkāśaṃ vṛddhaṃ daśarathaṃ nṛpam
english: Those messengers, at the king's command, having been admitted into the royal palace, beheld the aged king Daśaratha, resplendent as a god.

sanskrit: baddhāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve dūtā vigatasādhvasāḥ rājānaṃ prayatā vākyam abruvan madhurākṣaram
english: All the messengers, with palms joined together, free from fear, composed, addressed the king in words of sweet syllables.

sanskrit: maithilo janako rājā sāgnihotrapuraskṛtaḥ kuśalaṃ cāvyayaṃ caiva sopādhyāyapurohitam
english: "King Janaka of Mithilā, accompanied by the agnihotra rite, inquires after your health and well-being, along with your preceptors and priests—"

sanskrit: muhur muhur madhurayā snehasaṃyuktayā girā janakas tvāṃ mahārāja pṛcchate sapuraḥsaram
english: "—again and again with sweet and affectionate words, O great king, Janaka asks after you and all your retinue."

sanskrit: pṛṣṭvā kuśalam avyagraṃ vaideho mithilādhipaḥ kauśikānumate vākyaṃ bhavantam idam abravīt
english: "Having inquired calmly after your welfare, Vaideha, the lord of Mithilā, with Kauśika's approval, spoke these words to you:"

sanskrit: pūrvaṃ pratijñā viditā vīryaśulkā mamātmajā rājānaś ca kṛtāmarṣā nirvīryā vimukhīkṛtāḥ
english: "'My daughter's bride-price of valor was proclaimed long ago, and many kings, made angry and found lacking in valor, were turned away in disappointment.'

sanskrit: seyaṃ mama sutā rājan viśvāmitra puraḥsaraiḥ yadṛcchayāgatair vīrair nirjitā tava putrakaiḥ
english: "'That daughter of mine, O king, has now been won by your sons—those heroes who came here led by Viśvāmitra, as if by fortune's own design.'

sanskrit: tac ca rājan dhanur divyaṃ madhye bhagnaṃ mahātmanā rāmeṇa hi mahārāja mahatyāṃ janasaṃsadi
english: "'And that divine bow, O king, was broken in the midst of the great assembly by the noble Rāma, O great king, before the gathered multitude.'

sanskrit: asmai deyā mayā sītā vīryaśulkā mahātmane pratijñāṃ tartum icchāmi tad anujñātum arhasi
english: "'Sītā, whose bride-price is valor, should be given by me to this great-souled one; I wish to fulfill my vow—you should grant your permission for this.'

sanskrit: sopādhyāyo mahārāja purohitapuraskṛtaḥ śīghram āgaccha bhadraṃ te draṣṭum arhasi rāghavau
english: "'Come quickly, O great king, together with your preceptors, with your priests at the fore—may it be well with you—you should see the two Rāghavas.'

sanskrit: prītiṃ ca mama rājendra nirvartayitum arhasi putrayor ubhayyor eva prītiṃ tvam api lapsyase
english: "'You should fulfill my joy, O king of kings; and you yourself will also gain the joy of both your sons.'"

sanskrit: evaṃ videhādhipatir madhuraṃ vākyam abravīt viśvāmitrābhyanujñātaḥ śatānandamate sthitaḥ
english: Thus the lord of Videha spoke his sweet words, acting with Viśvāmitra's sanction and in accordance with Śatānanda's counsel.

sanskrit: dūtavākyaṃ tu tac chrutvā rājā paramaharṣitaḥ vasiṣṭhaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca mantriṇo 'nyāṃś ca so 'bravīt
english: Having heard those words of the messengers, the king was supremely delighted; he addressed Vasiṣṭha, Vāmadeva, his ministers, and others.

sanskrit: guptaḥ kuśikaputreṇa kausalyānandavardhanaḥ lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā videheṣu vasaty asau
english: "He who delights Kausalyā, protected by the son of Kuśika, dwells in Videha together with his brother Lakṣmaṇa."

sanskrit: dṛṣṭavīryas tu kākutstho janakena mahātmanā saṃpradānaṃ sutāyās tu rāghave kartum icchati
english: "The Kākutstha whose valor has been witnessed—the great-souled Janaka now wishes to bestow his daughter upon that Rāghava."

sanskrit: yadi vo rocate vṛttaṃ janakasya mahātmanaḥ purīṃ gacchāmahe śīghraṃ mā bhūt kālasya paryayaḥ
english: "If this action of the great-souled Janaka pleases you, let us proceed to the city quickly—let there be no lapse of time."

sanskrit: mantriṇo bāḍham ity āhuḥ saha sarvair maharṣibhiḥ suprītaś cābravīd rājā śvo yātreti sa mantriṇaḥ
english: The ministers said "So be it" together with all the great sages; and the king, greatly pleased, told his ministers: "We depart tomorrow."

sanskrit: mantriṇas tu narendrasya rātriṃ paramasatkṛtāḥ ūṣuḥ pramuditāḥ sarve guṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ samanvitāḥ
english: The ministers of the lord of men, most excellently honored, passed that night in joy, all endowed with every virtue.

sanskrit: tato rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ sopādhyāyaḥ sabāndhavaḥ rājā daśaratho hṛṣṭaḥ sumantram idam abravīt
english: Then, when the night had passed, king Daśaratha, delighted, together with his preceptors and kinsmen, spoke thus to Sumantra:

sanskrit: adya sarve dhanādhyakṣā dhanam ādāya puṣkalam vrajantv agre suvihitā nānāratnasamanvitāḥ
english: "Today let all the treasurers, taking abundant wealth and adorned with various jewels, proceed well-arranged at the fore."

sanskrit: caturaṅgabalaṃ cāpi śīghraṃ niryātu sarvaśaḥ mamājñāsamakālaṃ ca yānayugyam anuttamam
english: "Let the fourfold army also march out quickly in full, and let the finest carriages and teams be readied simultaneously with my command."

sanskrit: vasiṣṭho vāmadevaś ca jābālir atha kāśyapaḥ mārkaṇḍeyaś ca dīrghāyur ṛṣiḥ kātyāyanas tathā
english: "Vasiṣṭha, Vāmadeva, Jābāli, Kāśyapa, the long-lived sage Mārkaṇḍeya, and Kātyāyana likewise—"

sanskrit: ete dvijāḥ prayāntv agre syandanaṃ yojayasva me yathā kālātyayo na syād dūtā hi tvarayanti mām
english: "—let these twice-born ones proceed at the fore; yoke my chariot, so that no time may be lost, for the messengers press me to hasten."

sanskrit: vacanāc ca narendrasya sā senā caturaṅgiṇī rājānam ṛṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ vrajantaṃ pṛṣṭhato 'nvagāt
english: At the command of the lord of men, that fourfold army followed behind as the king proceeded together with the sages.

sanskrit: gatvā caturahaṃ mārgaṃ videhān abhyupeyivān rājā tu janakaḥ śrīmāñ śrutvā pūjām akalpayat
english: Having traveled four days on the road and arrived in Videha, the glorious king Janaka, upon hearing of his coming, made arrangements to honor him.

sanskrit: tato rājānam āsādya vṛddhaṃ daśarathaṃ nṛpam janako mudito rājā harṣaṃ ca paramaṃ yayau uvāca ca naraśreṣṭho naraśreṣṭhaṃ mudānvitam
english: Then king Janaka, approaching the aged king Daśaratha, was filled with joy and felt supreme delight; and that best of men, filled with gladness, spoke to that best of men.

sanskrit: svāgataṃ te mahārāja diṣṭyā prāpto 'si rāghava putrayor ubhayoḥ prītiṃ lapsyase vīryanirjitām
english: "Welcome to you, O great king! By good fortune you have arrived, O Rāghava; you shall gain the joy of both your sons, won by their valor."

sanskrit: diṣṭyā prāpto mahātejā vasiṣṭho bhagavān ṛṣiḥ saha sarvair dvijaśreṣṭhair devair iva śatakratuḥ
english: "By good fortune the greatly resplendent venerable sage Vasiṣṭha has arrived, together with all the foremost twice-born, like Śatakratu with the gods."

sanskrit: diṣṭyā me nirjitā vighnā diṣṭyā me pūjitaṃ kulam rāghavaiḥ saha saṃbandhād vīryaśreṣṭhair mahātmabhiḥ
english: "By good fortune my obstacles are overcome; by good fortune my lineage is honored, through alliance with the Rāghavas—those great-souled ones supreme in valor."

sanskrit: śvaḥ prabhāte narendrendra nirvartayitum arhasi yajñasyānte naraśreṣṭha vivāham ṛṣisaṃmatam
english: "Tomorrow at dawn, O lord of lords of men, you should perform the marriage approved by the sages, at the conclusion of the sacrifice, O best of men."

sanskrit: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā ṛṣimadhye narādhipaḥ vākyaṃ vākyavidāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ pratyuvāca mahīpatim
english: Having heard those words of his, the lord of men, the foremost among those skilled in speech, spoke in return to that lord of the earth in the midst of the sages.

sanskrit: pratigraho dātṛvaśaḥ śrutam etan mayā purā yathā vakṣyasi dharmajña tat kariṣyāmahe vayam
english: "The acceptance of a gift lies in the giver's power—so I have heard from of old; whatever you, O knower of dharma, shall say, that we will do."

sanskrit: tad dharmiṣṭhaṃ yaśasyaṃ ca vacanaṃ satyavādinaḥ śrutvā videhādhipatiḥ paraṃ vismayam āgataḥ
english: Having heard that speech—so righteous, so glorious—from one who speaks only truth, the lord of Videha was filled with supreme wonder.

sanskrit: tataḥ sarve munigaṇāḥ parasparasamāgame harṣeṇa mahatā yuktās tāṃ niśām avasan sukham
english: Then all the bands of sages, gathered together with one another, filled with great joy, passed that night in happiness.

sanskrit: rājā ca rāghavau putrau niśāmya pariharṣitaḥ uvāsa paramaprīto janakena supūjitaḥ
english: The king too, having beheld his two Rāghava sons, was overjoyed; he passed the night in supreme delight, honored magnificently by Janaka.

sanskrit: janako 'pi mahātejāḥ kriyā dharmeṇa tattvavit yajñasya ca sutābhyāṃ ca kṛtvā rātrim uvāsa ha
english: The greatly resplendent Janaka too, a true knower of dharma and ritual, having performed the rites both for the sacrifice and for his daughters, passed the night.

sanskrit: tataḥ prabhāte janakaḥ kṛtakarmā maharṣibhiḥ uvāca vākyaṃ vākyajñaḥ śatānandaṃ purohitam
english: Then at dawn Janaka, having performed his duties along with the great sages, skilled in speech, addressed his priest Śatānanda.

sanskrit: bhrātā mama mahātejā yavīyān atidhārmikaḥ kuśadhvaja iti khyātaḥ purīm adhyavasac chubhām
english: "My younger brother, greatly resplendent and supremely righteous, known as Kuśadhvaja, dwells in a beautiful city—"

sanskrit: vāryāphalakaparyantāṃ pibann ikṣumatīṃ nadīm sāṃkāśyāṃ puṇyasaṃkāśāṃ vimānam iva puṣpakam
english: "—extending to the shores enclosed by water, drinking from the river Ikṣumatī, the city of Sāṃkāśyā, lovely as a sacred site, like the Puṣpaka aerial car."

sanskrit: tam ahaṃ draṣṭum icchāmi yajñagoptā sa me mataḥ prītiṃ so 'pi mahātejā imāṃ bhoktā mayā saha
english: "I wish to see him; he is the guardian of my sacrifice in my view; that greatly resplendent one shall also share in this joy together with me."

sanskrit: śāsanāt tu narendrasya prayayuḥ śīghravājibhiḥ samānetuṃ naravyāghraṃ viṣṇum indrājñayā yathā
english: At the lord of men's command, they went forth with swift horses to bring that tiger among men, as if to summon Viṣṇu at Indra's bidding.

sanskrit: ājñayā tu narendrasya ājagāma kuśadhvajaḥ
english: By the command of the lord of men, Kuśadhvaja came.

sanskrit: sa dadarśa mahātmānaṃ janakaṃ dharmavatsalam so 'bhivādya śatānandaṃ rājānaṃ cāpi dhārmikam
english: He beheld the great-souled Janaka, devoted to dharma; having paid his respects to Śatānanda and to the righteous king as well,

sanskrit: rājārhaṃ paramaṃ divyam āsanaṃ cādhyarohata upaviṣṭāv ubhau tau tu bhrātarāv amitaujasau
english: he ascended the supreme and radiant seat befitting a king. Both brothers, of unbounded splendor, then sat together.

sanskrit: preṣayām āsatur vīrau mantriśreṣṭhaṃ sudāmanam gaccha mantripate śīghram aikṣvākam amitaprabham ātmajaiḥ saha durdharṣam ānayasva samantriṇam
english: The two heroes sent forth their foremost minister Sudāmana: "Go quickly, O lord of ministers; bring here the Ikṣvāku, of boundless splendor, who is difficult to assail—bring him with his sons and his ministers."

sanskrit: aupakāryāṃ sa gatvā tu raghūṇāṃ kulavardhanam dadarśa śirasā cainam abhivādyedam abravīt
english: Going to the encampment, he found the increaser of Raghu's lineage; bowing his head in salutation, he spoke these words:

sanskrit: ayodhyādhipate vīra vaideho mithilādhipaḥ sa tvāṃ draṣṭuṃ vyavasitaḥ sopādhyāyapurohitam
english: "O hero, lord of Ayodhyā, the Vaideha, lord of Mithilā, is resolved to see you together with your preceptors and priests."

sanskrit: mantriśreṣṭhavacaḥ śrutvā rājā sarṣigaṇas tadā sabandhur agamat tatra janako yatra vartate
english: Having heard the words of the foremost minister, the king, together with the groups of sages and his kinsmen, went to where Janaka was.

sanskrit: sa rājā mantrisahitaḥ sopādhyāyaḥ sabāndhavaḥ vākyaṃ vākyavidāṃ śreṣṭho vaideham idam abravīt
english: That king, accompanied by his ministers, with his preceptors and kinsmen, the foremost among those skilled in speech, spoke these words to the Vaideha:

sanskrit: viditaṃ te mahārāja ikṣvākukuladaivatam vaktā sarveṣu kṛtyeṣu vasiṣṭho bhagavān ṛṣiḥ
english: "You know, O great king, that the venerable sage Vasiṣṭha, the divinity of the Ikṣvāku lineage, is the spokesman in all matters."

sanskrit: viśvāmitrābhyanujñātaḥ saha sarvair maharṣibhiḥ eṣa vakṣyati dharmātmā vasiṣṭho me yathākramam
english: "This righteous-souled Vasiṣṭha, with Viśvāmitra's sanction and together with all the great sages, will speak on my behalf in proper order."

sanskrit: tūṣṇīṃbhūte daśarathe vasiṣṭho bhagavān ṛṣiḥ uvāca vākyaṃ vākyajño vaidehaṃ sapurohitam
english: When Daśaratha fell silent, the venerable sage Vasiṣṭha, skilled in speech, addressed the Vaideha together with his priest.

sanskrit: avyaktaprabhavo brahmā śāśvato nitya avyayaḥ tasmān marīciḥ saṃjajñe marīceḥ kaśyapaḥ sutaḥ
english: "Brahmā, whose origin is unmanifest, is eternal, ever-present, and imperishable; from him was born Marīci; from Marīci, Kaśyapa is the son."

sanskrit: vivasvān kaśyapāj jajñe manur vaivaisvataḥ smṛtaḥ manuḥ prajāpatiḥ pūrvam ikṣvākus tu manoḥ sutaḥ
english: "From Kaśyapa was born Vivasvān; Manu is known as Vaivasvata; Manu was the primeval Prajāpati; and Ikṣvāku is Manu's son."

sanskrit: tam ikṣvākum ayodhyāyāṃ rājānaṃ viddhi pūrvakam ikṣvākos tu sutaḥ śrīmān vikukṣir udapadyata
english: "Know that Ikṣvāku was the first king in Ayodhyā; from Ikṣvāku the glorious Vikukṣi was born."

sanskrit: vikukṣes tu mahātejā bāṇaḥ putraḥ pratāpavān bāṇasya tu mahātejā anaraṇyaḥ pratāpavān
english: "From Vikukṣi, the greatly resplendent and mighty Bāṇa was born as son; from Bāṇa, the greatly resplendent and mighty Anaraṇya."

sanskrit: anaraṇyāt pṛthur jajñe triśaṅkus tu pṛthoḥ sutaḥ triśaṅkor abhavat putro dhundhumāro mahāyaśāḥ
english: "From Anaraṇya Pṛthu was born; Triśaṅku is Pṛthu's son; from Triśaṅku was born the greatly renowned Dhundhumāra."

sanskrit: dhundhumārān mahātejā yuvanāśvo mahārathaḥ yuvanāśvasutaḥ śrīmān māndhātā pṛthivīpatiḥ
english: "From Dhundhumāra, the greatly resplendent great warrior Yuvanāśva; Yuvanāśva's son, the glorious Māndhātā, lord of the earth."

sanskrit: māndhātus tu sutaḥ śrīmān susaṃdhir udapadyata susaṃdher api putrau dvau dhruvasaṃdhiḥ prasenajit
english: "From Māndhātā the glorious son Susaṃdhi was born; and Susaṃdhi had two sons: Dhruvasaṃdhi and Prasenajit."

sanskrit: yaśasvī dhruvasaṃdhes tu bharato nāma nāmataḥ bharatāt tu mahātejā asito nāma jāyata
english: "From the renowned Dhruvasaṃdhi was born one named Bharata; from Bharata the greatly resplendent one named Asita was born."

sanskrit: saha tena gareṇaiva jātaḥ sa sagaro 'bhavat sagarasyāsamañjas tu asamañjād athāṃśumān
english: "Born together with that poison itself, he became Sagara; from Sagara came Asamañjas; from Asamañjas then Aṃśumān."

sanskrit: dilīpo 'ṃśumataḥ putro dilīpasya bhagīrathaḥ bhagīrathāt kakutsthaś ca kakutsthasya raghus tathā
english: "Dilīpa is Aṃśumān's son; from Dilīpa, Bhagīratha; from Bhagīratha, Kākutstha; and from Kākutstha, Raghu likewise."

sanskrit: raghos tu putras tejasvī pravṛddhaḥ puruṣādakaḥ kalmāṣapādo hy abhavat tasmāj jātas tu śaṅkhaṇaḥ
english: "Raghu's son, the fierce and grown mighty man-eater, became Kalmāṣapāda; from him was born Śaṅkhaṇa."

sanskrit: sudarśanaḥ śaṅkhaṇasya agnivarṇaḥ sudarśanāt śīghragas tv agnivarṇasya śīghragasya maruḥ sutaḥ
english: "Sudarśana is from Śaṅkhaṇa; Agnivarṇa from Sudarśana; Śīghraga from Agnivarṇa; and Maru is the son of Śīghraga."

sanskrit: maroḥ praśuśrukas tv āsīd ambarīṣaḥ praśuśrukāt ambarīṣasya putro 'bhūn nahuṣaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ
english: "From Maru came Praśuśruka; from Praśuśruka, Ambarīṣa; Ambarīṣa's son was Nahuṣa, lord of the earth."

sanskrit: nahuṣasya yayātis tu nābhāgas tu yayātijaḥ nābhāgasya babhūvāja ajād daśaratho 'bhavat tasmād daśarathāj jātau bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau
english: "From Nahuṣa, Yayāti; from Yayāti, Nābhāga; from Nābhāga, Aja was born; from Aja, Daśaratha came to be; and from that Daśaratha were born the two brothers Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa."

sanskrit: ādivaṃśaviśuddhānāṃ rājñāṃ paramadharmiṇām ikṣvākukulajātānāṃ vīrāṇāṃ satyavādinām
english: "Of kings pure in their primordial lineage, supremely righteous, born in the Ikṣvāku line, heroes, speakers of truth—"

sanskrit: rāmalakṣmaṇayor arthe tvatsute varaye nṛpa sadṛśābhyāṃ naraśreṣṭha sadṛśe dātum arhasi
english: "—for the sake of Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa I ask for your daughters, O king; O best of men, for these two who are their equals in worth, you should give those who are their equals in worth."
